svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lathe: 48 mm outside x 98 mm, then a 40 mm spigot 12 long.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back: bore 35.16 mm, 60 deep (a coupler must slide in).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bore 30 mm from 60 to 94 mm: the air plenum; 4 mm front wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spigot: 14 mm bore 6.5 mm below the axis, through, for the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: cable grommet. Tap three M4 holes 6 mm deep, 4 from its end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Button hole 8.5 mm on the button line, 30 mm from the back;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: spotface 14 mm down to 20.3 mm from the axis.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Six 5 mm outlets 79 mm from the back face, at 0, 45, 135,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 225, 270 and 315 deg from the button line toward the top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Speaker pocket on the far side: 20.5 mm, flat floor 16.8 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the axis, 79 mm back; 3 mm wire hole into the plenum.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Water exit 4.5 mm at 45 deg on top, axis crossing 12 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: above the axis 72 mm from the back; groove 4.5 x 4 on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: coupler, nose and speaker fit; blow through outlets.
